fusions.name: Ram Piston
fusions.desc: Drives a piston ram into the target, which deals 16 damage, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Landslide Charge
fusions.desc: Plants your braces and sets off a blasting charge in the rock underfoot, which deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Locked Stance
fusions.desc: Locks your leg braces into the ground: for 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Gyro Ballast
fusions.desc: A spinning gyroscope keeps you planted: your armour rises by 10%.
